claims.text: Hierarchical attention narrows the horizon-720 gap versus horizon-336 for Crossformer on ETTh1, Traffic.
Crossformer is best characterised as cross-dimension transformer with hierarchical encoder.

evidence.description: Crossformer MSE at horizon 720 is 28% below the closest transformer baseline on ETTh1.

limitations.text: Confidence intervals or standard errors are not reported for the headline metric.
Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested.

future_work.text: Combining channel-independent tokenisation with variate-token attention.
Reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
